# Venus Clinical Report

**Sample:** `r params$sample`

## Summary

- **TMB:** `r if (file.exists(params$tmb)) { tmb_data <- read.delim(params$tmb); tmb_data$tmb[1] } else { "N/A" }` mut/Mb

## Variants

```{r variants, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (file.exists(params$vcf)) {
    lines <- readLines(params$vcf)
    variant_lines <- lines[!grepl("^#", lines)]
    cat(sprintf("**Total variants:** %d\n\n", length(variant_lines)))
    if (length(variant_lines) > 0 && length(variant_lines) <= 20) {
        for (line in variant_lines) {
            fields <- strsplit(line, "\t")[[1]]
            cat(sprintf("- %s:%s %s>%s\n", fields[1], fields[2], fields[4], fields[5]))
        }
    } else if (length(variant_lines) > 20) {
        cat("_Showing first 20 of", length(variant_lines), "variants_\n\n")
        for (i in 1:20) {
            fields <- strsplit(variant_lines[i], "\t")[[1]]
            cat(sprintf("- %s:%s %s>%s\n", fields[1], fields[2], fields[4], fields[5]))
        }
    }
} else {
    cat("No VCF file found.")
}
```
